auditCaseId.title: Audit Case Id
auditCaseId.description: The 15- or 18-character Salesforce record Id of the Audit_Case__c to draft an evidence request for.
auditCaseId.einstein:description: The 15- or 18-character Salesforce record Id of the Audit_Case__c the auditor wants an evidence-request drafted for. Audit Case Ids start with a05. Extract it directly from the user request, e.g. "draft an evidence request for audit case a05gL00000JtZ74QAF".
